Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent searched for "Xenoa release date film" and interpreted the results incorrectly, conflating "Xeno" (2025) with "Xenoa" (2007). This mistake was compounded by the failure to differentiate between the two distinct films based on release years and metadata, despite reliable sources like IMDb and Wikipedia listing "Xenoa" as a Filipino film released in 2007. The agent should have clarified the ambiguity regarding the title but instead proceeded under the incorrect assumption that "Xenoa" referred to the 2025 film, resulting in faulty subsequent steps.
